assertions.message: Both milling-capable machines are unavailable from the intervention through the hard horizon.
At least one 900-second milling operation remains, so infeasibility is caused by capability/window/horizon constraints rather than due-date tardiness.

hard_contradiction.explanation: CNC02 and CNC03 are the only milling-capable resources and both are unavailable for every remaining second through the hard horizon; soft due dates cannot relax this hard contradiction.
